description:
Approved by the user (relayed by fz-engine, 2026-11-20). Scope restated by the user on 2026-11-23 (page ../fz-t93.26.html).

On develop 59e5bda1e, interp --dump backend of tools/distill-telemetry.exs under 8 agenda orders gave identical stdout but 5 distinct backend plans (FIFO 1101 executables, LIFO 1133). The paper (scratch /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/t93_26/, r2/, r3/) found five causes; this ticket fixes three of them in one commit:
- M1: NameableModules (identity.rs) keeps modules in first-noted order; built in a fixed order instead (23 print-order fixtures become identical).
- M2: resolve_module_value_call prepares callees one at a time, so a partial preparation seeds wide ActivationInputs (seed_activation_producer). S1: plan every callee before preparing any (plan_direct_call, then prepare_keyed_call), as the protocol path already does.
- M3: ActivationInputAlternatives' 8-row budget merges rows depending on batching. P: keep the full antichain as members and derive rows from it (members, or their join past 8); the per-value check in join_all and the in-place truncation in rebuild go. Budget stays 8.
Also: the drive.rs comment claiming the corpus makes no merges is corrected (the distiller makes 61).
TDD: the Map.keys(Map.put(%{}, :a, 1)) program and the 10-call IO.inspect program as numbered fixtures; a cfg(test) order knob and a test that their plans match under fifo and lifo.

Done when: the distiller's plan keys are identical under every order, and M1, M2 and M3 are gone; no pin moves (measured). Byte-identical plans everywhere moves to the follow-up tickets for M4, M5 and the untraced fixtures.
title: The distiller's backend plan does not depend on job order
